# 24·Hour·HAZWOPER

> The OSHA 24-hour HAZWOPER online for occasional site workers and workers below exposure limits under 29 CFR 1910.120(e)(3)(ii)-(iii). $169.99, certificate included.

24·Hour·HAZWOPER (https://24-hour.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs OSHA 24-Hour, Cal/OSHA 24-Hour, 8-Hour Refresher, 4-Hour Awareness training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://24-hour.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [OSHA 24 Hour HAZWOPER Training](https://24-hour.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-24-hour-hazwoper-training): $169.99 per seat, 24 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e). The OSHA 24-hour initial HAZWOPER for occasional site workers and workers in monitored, low-exposure areas. Enroll: https://24-hour.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-24-hour-hazwoper-training?buy=581
- [Cal/OSHA 24-Hour HAZWOPER Training](https://24-hour.hazwoperosha.us/courses/cal-osha-24-hour-hazwoper-training): $189.99 per seat, 24 Hours, 8 CCR 5192(e). The 24-hour initial HAZWOPER written to Cal/OSHA Title 8 section 5192 for California workers. Enroll: https://24-hour.hazwoperosha.us/courses/cal-osha-24-hour-hazwoper-training?buy=576
- [OSHA 8 Hour HAZWOPER Refresher Training](https://24-hour.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-refresher-training): $59.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e)(8). The annual 8-hour refresher that keeps a 24-hour (or 40-hour) certificate current. Enroll: https://24-hour.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-refresher-training?buy=595
- [OSHA 4-Hour HAZWOPER First Responder Awareness Level Training](https://24-hour.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-4-hour-hazwoper-first-responder-awareness-level-training): $61.99 per seat, 4 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(q)(6)(i). First responder awareness training for staff who may discover a release but won't work on a waste site. Enroll: https://24-hour.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-4-hour-hazwoper-first-responder-awareness-level-training?buy=1099

- [What happens on the one-day field experience](https://24-hour.hazwoperosha.us/guides/the-24-hour-field-day): The 24-hour comes with a supervised day on site. Here's what a good one covers.
